answer: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.CRP = '+' AND p.Description IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient p WHERE p.Admission = '-' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID = p.ID AND l.HCT IS NOT NULL AND (l.HCT <= 29 OR l.HCT >= 52)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID = p.ID AND l.RNP NOT IN ('negative','') AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 16)

SELECT ROUND(AVG(l.TP - 8.5), 3) FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX = 'F' AND l.TP > 8.5 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Examination e WHERE e.ID = l.ID AND (',' || REPLACE(e.Diagnosis,' ','') || ',') LIKE '%,SLE,%')
SELECT SUM(p.SEX = 'F') AS women, SUM(p.SEX = 'M') AS men FROM Patient p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID = p.ID AND l.RNP NOT IN ('negative','') AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 32)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Examination WHERE Thrombosis > 0 AND "Examination Date" BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX = 'F' AND l.DNA IS NOT NULL AND l.DNA <> '' AND CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) < 8

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, l.Date, l."U-PRO" FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE l."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND l.Date = (SELECT MAX(l2.Date) FROM Laboratory l2 WHERE l2.ID = p.ID AND l2."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY p.ID

SELECT p.Birthday FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE l.GPT < 60 AND p.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE RNP NOT IN ('negative','') AND CAST(RNP AS REAL) >= 16) GROUP BY p.ID ORDER BY MAX(l.GPT) DESC, p.ID ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', l.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) - (strftime('%m-%d', l.Date) < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)) AS age, p.Diagnosis FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.Admission LIKE '+%' AND l.DNA IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) DESC, l.Date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(p.SEX = 'F') - SUM(p.SEX = 'M') FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE l.Date = (SELECT MAX(Date) FROM Laboratory WHERE ID = p.ID) AND l.RNP NOT IN ('negative','') AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) >= 32
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND Admission LIKE '+%' AND "First Date" >= '1998-01-01' AND "First Date" <= '1998-12-31'
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE Admission LIKE '+%' AND "First Date" BETWEEN '1998-02-15' AND '1998-02-28' AND Birthday IS NOT NULL ORDER BY Birthday ASC, ID ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM"), 1) FROM Examination WHERE "Examination Date" BETWEEN '1993-10-01' AND '1993-10-31' AND (',' || REPLACE(Diagnosis,' ','') || ',') LIKE '%,SLE,%'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE LOWER(Diagnosis) LIKE '%psoriatic arthritis%'
SELECT SEX, COUNT(*) FROM Patient p WHERE SEX IN ('F','M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID = p.ID AND l.GPT >= 60) GROUP BY SEX

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID = p.ID AND l.SM IN ('negative','0')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Examination e WHERE e.ID = p.ID AND e.Thrombosis > 0) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID = p.ID AND l."U-PRO" IN ('+1(30)','+2(100)','100','30','300','>=300','>=1000'))

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p WHERE p.SEX = 'F' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID = p.ID AND l.WBC > 3.5 AND l.WBC < 9.0 AND (l.FG <= 150 OR l.FG >= 450) AND l.RNP NOT IN ('negative','') AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 15)
